extracted.intended_audience: readers of reuters.com and Reuters journalists
extracted.subtask_description: Describes and implements Reuters' Trust Principles as guiding editorial standards for journalists, including core values (integrity, independence, freedom from bias) and transparency practices such as publishing methodology 'Backstory' and linking to the principles on stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Reuters and its employees must act at all times with integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as one of the core Thomson Reuters Trust Principles (created in 1941), integrity is described as an indispensable compass built into Reuters' charter and founding documents; it is part of the uncompromising standards that have guided journalists for decades.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Reuters and its employees must maintain independence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named explicitly among the Trust Principles, independence is emphasized as essential to Reuters' editorial mission and institutional charter to ensure reporting free from external control or influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom from bias
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists must maintain freedom from bias in reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Freedom from bias is called out as a principal Trust Principle that, together with integrity and independence, aims to help Reuters report honestly and fairly in challenging environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report honestly and fairly
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting should be honest and fair.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Trust Principles are said to help journalists 'report honestly and fairly'; this frames accuracy, fairness, and balanced treatment of subjects as key quality criteria for stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology transparency ('Backstory')
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide explanations (called 'Backstory') of how particular pieces were reported, either as a statement of methodology or a Q&A with a Reuters journalist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offered 'from time to time' when useful to readers, Backstory entries are intended to share more information about the way Reuters works and the standards under which it operates, reinforcing commitments to accuracy and lack of bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prominent disclosure of Trust Principles on stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a link to the Trust Principles at the bottom of all stories on reuters.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This procedural change increases visibility of the principles for readers and signals institutional commitment to the standards; it's a transparency/visibility measure rather than a story-level editorial technique.
